tools.name: make_dashboard_from_file
tools.description: Turn a spreadsheet export (Excel or CSV, up to 10 MB) into an Every Number dashboard. Returns a read-only dashboard link and every number on it with its receipt: the definition, the rows it used, and the rows it left out with the reason. Fixed rules lay out the screen and a database counts every num

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "make_dashboard_from_file" appears informational but accepts parameters (file_content) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: file_url, file_content, file_name, content_encoding, sheet, file
